_comment: The stage catalog (AR-07): one ordered list shared by the pipeline runner (scripts/ai/pipeline.sh), the progress model and the docs (docs/reference/pipeline.md, generated). The stage ids are public and stable from drupilot 1.0 on: never rename one; a new stage is added at its place. state.json keeps 0.9's coarse stages, derived from these through coarse_stage (CC-20). Fields: id; label; kind (det, det+tab, det+ai, ai, outward); weight (relative effort for the progress percent, provisional: the headline is 'stage k/N', never the percent); when (every condition must hold, from the closed set in conditions); skip_reason (the reason recorded when the named condition is false: the stage is then 'skipped', not absent); tabs (config/choices.json keys the stage asks); subs (sub-step ids); outputs; gate (what must hold to leave the stage); coarse_stage (the state.json stage it records, or null); procedure_anchor ({skill, heading}: the skill step that defines the procedure, or null while none does).

conditions.track:standard: the upgrade plan's track is standard (a Drupal 8+ source)
conditions.track:d7-assisted: the upgrade plan's track is d7-assisted (a Drupal 7 source)
conditions.hops: the upgrade plan has at least one major hop (hops is not [])
conditions.worklist:ai: worklist.json has open items in an ai-* lane
conditions.optin: the developer opted in (it is never run by default)

stages.label: Check the environment
stages.gate: preflight exits 0 for the next stage's profile (INV2)

stages.label: Draft the upgrade plan
outputs: upgrade plan (draft), frozen in the lock
stages.gate: the target major and PHP target are confirmed (a tab, a pre-answer or the auto default); a Drupal 7 source in an auto run stops here (D7-AUTO)

stages.label: Set up the test-bed
stages.gate: the toolchain smoke test passes; a hand-edited config is never overwritten (INV5)

stages.label: Assess viability
stages.gate: none: it always emits a staged plan, even at XL

stages.label: Finalize the upgrade plan
outputs: upgrade plan (final), frozen in the lock
stages.gate: the core target is confirmed; the final plan only adds hops or raises the floor over the draft

stages.label: Rewrite Drupal 7 code (experimental)
stages.gate: DRUPILOT_EXPERIMENTAL_D7=on; never in an auto run

stages.label: Upgrade the Drupal API
stages.gate: Rector reaches a fixpoint within 3 iterations, else a warning

stages.label: Adapt to the PHP target
stages.gate: floor violations and removed constructs become worklist items, never silently dropped

stages.label: Fix what the tools cannot
stages.gate: per-item and per-file gates; an unresolved item becomes needs-human

procedure_anchor.heading: 5. Minimal manual changes (what Rector cannot do)

stages.label: Validate
stages.gate: with DRUPILOT_FIXPOINT=enforce, exit 3 when not converged; the info.yml check (INV11)

procedure_anchor.heading: 6. The validate loop (after each batch of changes)

stages.label: Test
stages.gate: the preservation verdict is computed, never fabricated (INV3)

procedure_anchor.heading: 5. Run the suites and iterate to green

stages.label: Report and patch
stages.gate: port-summary --strict exits 3 on a blocking issue

stages.label: Contribute upstream
stages.gate: guard-contrib.sh asks before any push; never in an auto run (INV1)
